why: The MW11 DAM simulator is a named Kyoto Kagaku training and performance-assessment device, not a general instructional element.
name: Kyoto Kagaku MW11 difficult airway management simulator
product_description: A high-fidelity airway-management simulator made by Kyoto Kagaku that supports procedural training and records objective performance measures across graded difficult-airway scenarios.

why: KYPO CRP is a named, reusable cloud software platform for provisioning cybersecurity sandboxes, delivering tasks and hints, checking answers, and collecting learning analytics.
name: KYPO Cyber Range Platform (KYPO CRP)
product_description: KYPO CRP is an open-source cloud-based platform developed for running hands-on cybersecurity training in provisioned virtual sandboxes with assessment and instructor analytics.
